title: Among the Giants
author: Ming Cao
description: I often worked with collage and painting while studying and working in historic preservation. For this map, I wanted to see how those techniques could work with a 3D terrain model. I used Python and PyVista to build the mountain form of Lalashan, Taiwan, from a digital elevation model (DEM), then traced the giant-tree trail across its slopes. The trees and waterfalls were cut from the classical Chinese paintings listed below and collaged in Photoshop.
